name: Katra & a Mountain Pause
description: Time for your Katra visit, followed by a gentler hill-country stay.

itinerary.title: Arrive & settle in Katra
itinerary.description: Meet the agreed transfer and check into your Katra stay. Confirm official registration and travel requirements directly with the Shrine Board.

itinerary.title: Your pilgrimage day
itinerary.description: Keep the day around your own approved pilgrimage arrangements. Darshan access, helicopter services, priority access, and related tickets are not promised or included.

itinerary.title: A pause in Patnitop
itinerary.description: Travel into the hills for a quieter final night. Timing depends on the completion of your Katra visit.

itinerary.title: Until next time
itinerary.description: Check out and take the arranged transfer for your onward journey. Departure timings and road buffers will be confirmed in your proposal.
